comparison.objective: Tear one paper-towel sheet at its perforation, then use it to wipe objects off a mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual tensile tearing of a deformable perforated sheet followed by wiping.
comparison.success_condition: Outer sheet torn and used to remove all yellow cubes from the blue mat; tear-quality and wiping tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Both tasks create separation at a manufactured weak line, but this task tests deformable tensile tearing and wiping; the candidate tests coaxial rigid-tool stabilization, discrete hammer impact, protection of retained coils, and recovery of four free metal fragments.
